critical_code_review_comments: enhanced.tsx applies red palette by mutating shared `colors` at runtime and then calling reloadApp() so route StyleSheets re-run on next boot with the mutated palette. Works, but any hot-reload/dev-refresh during testing that doesn't re-execute index.js will drop the red until AsyncStorage bootstrap runs again. Fine for prod (native reload always runs index.js), just noting for tester context.
enhanced.tsx :57 accept() does not revert the local `enhanced=false` state if apiFetch fails partway (persistEnhancedFlag is called AFTER the POST /consent succeeds — that's correct).
